reviewKind: Manual source review plus read-only hashes and whitespace; no runtime or compilation

checks.invariant: Views retain owned original geometry and immutable revision/preview identity
checks.basis: Existing structural validator returns isolated typed arrays; session captures a committed object before stamping; branch queries require ready/current state; no physics step or state write occurs

checks.invariant: Body contact selection uses exact bounded arithmetic
checks.basis: Integer Q coordinates, exact slab fractions, safe-integer cross products bounded below 2^42, canonical reduced times, explicit boundary and index tie order

checks.invariant: Rays preserve consistent grid ownership and face normals
checks.basis: Clip then compute a direction-owned starting voxel; advance every tied axis; choose the first entering grid face even when it ties a world boundary; do not use an epsilon

checks.invariant: Queries reject excessive enumeration and malformed data rather than returning false clear
checks.basis: Reserve clipped candidate cell counts before visitation; copy bounded array data from descriptors before using methods; strict fields, finite integer units and supported unique material filters

checks.invariant: Geometric support is distinct from structural stability
checks.basis: Require a fitting body, select minimum downward gap, sum no loads, and return each co-nearest footprint overlap; no solver prediction claimed

findingsAddressed: Canonicalize signed zero in contact-time fractions
Report an entering face instead of initial penetration for grid-plane ray starts
Resolve simultaneous internal-plane and world-entry normals in X/Y/Z order
Avoid invoking caller-provided array methods or inherited iterators while consuming bounded data
notProven: Authored test assertions, type correctness, SDK compilation or public-entry integration
Actual physical horizon agreement and exact replay
GPU equivalence, bounded rendering response or frame performance
Complete distant-support change reports, fragment motion or actor-terrain response
